title: VPN connection fails for remote users
description: Users are unable to establish VPN connections, receiving error 619. This is affecting the entire remote sales team. Initial checks in Splunk show high load on the primary VPN concentrator.
resolution: Failed VPN concentrator was taken out of rotation via load balancer. Configuration was restored from backup and device was rebooted successfully.

title: PROD-APP-07 experiencing high CPU utilization
description: Server PROD-APP-07 is consistently at 95% CPU, causing slow response times for the customer portal. Alerts were triggered in ServiceNow. The issue started after the last deployment.
resolution: Identified a memory leak in the recent code deployment. Rolled back the application version to the previous stable release and restarted the service.

title: User account lockout due to repeated failed logins
description: User jsmith@company.com is locked out of Okta after multiple failed MFA attempts. The user confirms they are using the correct credentials.
resolution: Unlocked the user account in Okta and verified no malicious activity via CrowdStrike logs. User was guided through resetting their authenticator app.

title: Database replication lag on reporting server
description: Replication lag between primary DB-SQL-01 and replica DB-REP-02 is over 30 minutes. This is causing stale data in the nightly BI reports.
resolution: Identified a long-running query blocking the replication process. Killed the blocking session and optimized the offending query index.

title: CrowdStrike alert for suspicious PowerShell execution
description: CrowdStrike flagged a high-severity alert on workstation WIN10-USER-45 for obfuscated PowerShell commands. The host is isolated.
resolution: Forensic analysis found a malicious script downloaded via phishing email. Removed the malware, cleared persistence mechanisms, and re-imaged the workstation.

title: Terraform apply failing for network module
description: Terraform pipeline is failing during `terraform apply` for the new VPC module with an AWS provider authentication error. The plan stage succeeded.
resolution: Regenerated the expired AWS access key used by the Terraform service account and updated the secret in the CI/CD vault.

title: File server DFS-01 is unreachable
description: Users cannot access shared drives on the file server DFS-01. Network ping fails, and the physical server appears offline.
resolution: Found a failed power supply unit in the server. Replaced the faulty PSU and brought the server back online. Verified share accessibility.

title: Oracle database ORA-12541 error on PROD-DB-02
description: Application servers cannot connect to PROD-DB-02, throwing ORA-12541: TNS no listener. The database service is running.
resolution: Restarted the Oracle TNS listener service on the database server. Verified listener.ora configuration was correct.

title: WiFi dropping in Building C East Wing
description: Multiple users in Building C report intermittent WiFi disconnections. The issue is localized to access points on the 3rd floor.
resolution: Updated firmware on the affected Aruba access points and adjusted channel interference settings after a site survey.

title: ServiceNow integration with Jira is broken
description: The bi-directional sync between ServiceNow and Jira has stopped updating tickets. Last successful sync was 12 hours ago.
resolution: Restarted the middleware integration service on the app server. Re-validated API credentials and re-established the OAuth connection.

title: Request for new service account for automated backups
description: DevOps team requires a new service account with specific permissions to S3 buckets for a backup automation project.
resolution: Created service account 'svc-backup-automation' in Okta. Assigned required IAM policy in AWS and provided credentials via secure channel.

title: Ansible playbook failing on web server group
description: Ansible playbook for deploying Apache configs fails on half the web server pool with a SSH connection timeout.
resolution: Identified a network ACL blocking Ansible control node IP. Updated the security group rules to allow traffic from the management subnet.

title: Suspicious inbound traffic on port 3389
description: SOC analyst observed repeated RDP brute-force attempts from an external IP range against firewall perimeter.
resolution: Blocked the offending IP range at the network firewall. Added the IOC to CrowdStrike for blocking and reviewed exposed RDP hosts.

title: Email delivery delays from internal SMTP server
description: Outbound emails from smtp-relay-01 are queued with significant delays. Internal mail flow is unaffected.
resolution: Cleared a large queue stuck due to a recipient domain's mail server being blacklisted. Adjusted smart host routing temporarily.

title: Backup failure for VM cluster VMW-CLUSTER-A
description: Nightly backup job for the VMware cluster failed with error 'Snapshot creation failed'. Several VMs are affected.
resolution: Identified and removed a stale snapshot on a template VM that was preventing new snapshots. Re-ran the backup job successfully.

title: User cannot access specific SharePoint site
description: User reports access denied to a critical project SharePoint site despite being in the correct AD group. Others in the group can access.
resolution: Ran a permission refresh script on the SharePoint site collection. Manually added the user directly to the site to restore access.

title: High latency on inter-office MPLS link
description: Voice call quality is poor between NY and London offices due to high latency and jitter on the primary MPLS circuit.
resolution: Worked with carrier to reroute traffic via a secondary path while they repaired a faulty node on the primary route.

title: MySQL slow query performance on PROD-APP-DB
description: Application is timing out due to slow queries on the MySQL database. CPU and memory are normal.
resolution: Enabled slow query log, identified a missing composite index on a large table. Created the index and query performance improved.

title: Okta SSO not working for Salesforce
description: Users cannot log into Salesforce via Okta SSO. Error states 'Invalid SAML Response'. Other apps work fine.
resolution: Regenerated the Salesforce SAML signing certificate in Okta and uploaded the new metadata to the Salesforce identity provider settings.

title: Kubernetes pod crashing in production cluster
description: Pod in the 'payment-service' deployment is crashing with OOMKilled errors. Logs show memory spike during transaction processing.
resolution: Increased the memory limit and request for the pod definition. Also fixed a code issue causing a memory leak in the application.

title: Phishing email reported by multiple users
description: Widespread phishing campaign mimicking internal HR detected. Several users clicked the link before reporting.
resolution: Quarantined the emails from all mailboxes using EDR. Blocked the URL at the firewall and DNS level. Sent company-wide alert.

title: SAP GUI client crashing on launch for specific users
description: Users on Windows 11 report SAP GUI crashing immediately after login. Event Viewer shows a .NET runtime error.
resolution: Pushed a registry fix via Group Policy to adjust the compatibility settings for the SAP executable on Windows 11 machines.

title: BGP session flapping on edge router RTR-EDGE-01
description: The BGP session with our ISP is flapping, causing brief internet outages. Logs show TCP resets.
resolution: Identified a faulty SFP module on the ISP side. Coordinated with ISP to replace the module, stabilizing the session.

title: Missing data in data warehouse ETL job
description: The daily ETL job from OLTP to data warehouse finished but is missing last 6 hours of transaction data.
resolution: Found that the source transaction log was full, halting replication. Freed up log space and re-ran the incremental ETL job.

title: New hire onboarding workflow stuck in ServiceNow
description: The IT onboarding workflow for a new hire is stuck at the 'Provision Laptop' stage. The task is unassigned.
resolution: Reassigned the stuck task to the correct queue and manually triggered the workflow engine to resume processing.

title: Azure VM deployment via Terraform failing
description: Terraform script for deploying a new Azure VM fails with error 'sku not available' in the target region.
resolution: Updated the Terraform script to specify an alternative VM SKU that is available in the region. Deployment succeeded.

title: Privileged account audit request
description: Compliance team requests an audit report of all users with Domain Admin privileges for quarterly review.
resolution: Exported a report from Active Directory and Okta of all accounts in privileged groups. Provided analysis of last login times.

title: Cannot RDP to jump server JMP-01
description: Administrators cannot RDP to the bastion host JMP-01. Connection times out. The server is pingable.
resolution: Windows Firewall on JMP-01 had a corrupted profile. Reset the firewall to default settings and re-applied the required rules.

title: Application returning HTTP 503 Service Unavailable
description: Customer-facing web app is returning 503 errors. The load balancer shows all backend servers are marked as unhealthy.
resolution: Restarted the application pool on all web servers after identifying a deadlock condition in the session state service.

title: Request to deprovision contractor access
description: HR notified that contractor C123's assignment has ended. Need to disable all system access immediately.
resolution: Disabled the user account in Okta, revoked all assigned application accesses, and terminated active sessions.

title: SAN storage array showing degraded performance
description: Performance metrics on the NetApp SAN show high latency on several LUNs hosting virtual machine datastores.
resolution: Identified and relocated several high-IO VMs to a different aggregate. Rebalanced the load and performance returned to normal.

title: PostgreSQL replication broken after OS update
description: Streaming replication to standby server DB-STBY-01 broke after a scheduled OS patching reboot.
resolution: Re-synced the standby by taking a fresh base backup from the primary and re-establishing the replication slot.

title: IDS alert for port scan from internal IP
description: Intrusion Detection System alerted on a horizontal port scan originating from an internal development server.
resolution: Investigated the server; found a misconfigured vulnerability scanner run by a developer. Stopped the scan and educated the user.

title: VoIP phone system call quality issues
description: Users report choppy audio and dropped calls on the Cisco VoIP system, primarily in the accounting department.
resolution: Prioritized VoIP traffic (DSCP EF) on the switch ports and enabled QoS on the core router to guarantee bandwidth.

title: Legacy application cannot connect to SQL Server 2019
description: An older internal app fails with connection errors after the database migration to SQL Server 2019.
resolution: Enabled TLS 1.2 on the application server and updated the connection string to require encrypted connection.

title: AWS CloudTrail logs not delivering to Splunk
description: CloudTrail logs have stopped being ingested into the Splunk index for the past 4 hours. S3 bucket has new logs.
resolution: Restarted the Splunk Heavy Forwarder instance and verified the S3 input configuration. Log flow resumed.

title: Database corruption detected in test environment
description: DBCC CHECKDB reported allocation errors on the TEST-SQL-01 database during routine maintenance.
resolution: Restored the database from the previous night's backup as it was a non-critical test environment.

title: User's multi-factor authentication device lost
description: User traveling internationally lost their YubiKey used for Okta MFA. Requires immediate reset and new method setup.
resolution: Removed the lost YubiKey from the user's Okta profile. Enabled SMS and email as temporary MFA and guided setup of TOTP app.

title: Web application firewall blocking legitimate traffic
description: The WAF is blocking POST requests to the login endpoint for users from a specific geographic region.
resolution: Created an exception rule in the WAF policy for the legitimate traffic pattern after confirming it was not malicious.

title: DNS resolution failure for internal domains
description: Internal DNS queries for .corp domains are failing sporadically. External DNS resolution works.
resolution: Restarted the DNS service on the secondary DNS server which had a corrupted cache. Verified zone transfers were working.

title: VMware vCenter alarm - datastore usage critical
description: vCenter is alerting that datastore DS-PROD-03 is at 98% capacity. Several VMs are stored here.
resolution: Identified and deleted old snapshots and migrated non-critical VMs to another datastore to free up space.

title: Oracle APEX application slow on complex reports
description: Users report timeouts when running specific analytical reports in the Oracle APEX application.
resolution: Added query hints and created materialized views for the complex reports to pre-aggregate the data.

title: Splunk search head not returning results
description: Splunk search head SH-01 is returning 'waiting for results' indefinitely. Indexers are healthy.
resolution: Cleared the search head's cache and restarted the splunkd service. Verified network connectivity to indexer cluster.

title: Request for firewall rule for new SaaS application
description: The marketing team needs outbound access to a new SaaS analytics platform on TCP port 443.
resolution: Performed a risk assessment of the SaaS provider. Implemented the firewall rule with source IP restriction and logged the change.

title: Ansible Tower job hung on 'running'
description: An Ansible Tower job to patch Linux servers has been stuck in 'running' state for 2 hours with no output.
resolution: Found a zombie process on the Ansible Tower node. Killed the process and restarted the Ansible Tower service.

title: Need to merge duplicate user accounts
description: Audit found two Active Directory accounts for the same user (jsmith). One is used for email, the other for applications.
resolution: Used AD tools to merge the accounts, preserving group memberships and mailbox. Disabled the duplicate account.

title: Broadcast storm detected on switch SW-ACCESS-12
description: Network monitoring shows a broadcast storm originating from switch in the marketing department, causing network slowness.
resolution: Disabled the offending network port where a misconfigured network device was causing a loop. Enabled storm-control on the switch.

title: MongoDB primary node election failure
description: The MongoDB replica set failed to elect a primary after a planned maintenance, leaving the cluster read-only.
resolution: Forced a reconfiguration of the replica set by removing the offline node's entry and initiating a new election.

title: Jenkins pipeline failing at Docker build stage
description: CI/CD pipeline fails when trying to build a Docker image, error: 'Cannot connect to the Docker daemon'.
resolution: Restarted the Docker service on the Jenkins build agent and added the Jenkins user to the docker group.

title: User receives 'Invalid security certificate' in browser
description: User cannot access the internal company portal, browser shows certificate error NET::ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID.
resolution: The internal CA certificate had expired on the web server. Renewed and deployed the new certificate via Group Policy.
